stories.heading: BIDEFORD FIGHT BACK AT CLEEVE
stories.body: Bideford twice came from behind to win 3–2 at Bishop’s Cleeve. Finn King-Smith cancelled out an own goal before Ross Langworthy restored the lead. Jordan Ewing’s penalty and Farren Simons’ late winner turned the contest.

stories.heading: DORCHESTER MAKE IT TEN STRAIGHT
stories.body: Dorchester reclaimed top spot with a 3–1 win at Sporting Club Inkberrow. The Magpies recovered from falling behind to record their tenth successive league victory. Player-coach Will Spetch praised their determination and togetherness.

stories.heading: KEMPSTER RESCUES WILLAND LATE
stories.body: Bailey Kempster’s stoppage-time strike earned Willand a 3–3 draw at Slimbridge. His second goal of the afternoon cancelled out Olly Sully’s late effort. Joel Jackson was also on target for Rovers.

stories.heading: TERRAS KEEP UNBEATEN RUN GOING
stories.body: Weymouth made it ten league games unbeaten with a 3–0 win at Barnstaple. Toby Holmes and Sam Jackson struck early before Tor Swann added the third. The Terras remained second, two points behind Dorchester.

stories.heading: FALMOUTH HOLD SUPERMARINE
stories.body: Falmouth earned a 1–1 draw at Swindon Supermarine. Luke Barner put Town ahead before Partridge equalised after the break. Marine surrendered top spot and finished Saturday third, level on points with second-placed Weymouth.

stories.heading: WESTBURY WIN IT AT THE DEATH
stories.body: Westbury reached the play-off places with a dramatic 1–0 win over Hungerford. Eben Mortimer-Taylor struck deep into stoppage time. The visitors finished with eight players, while two further red cards went to their bench.
